subject: Co-sell enablement: commercial routing & telemetry checklist
messages:
From: Claire Park <claire@datacloud.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Co-sell enablement: commercial routing & telemetry checklist

Hi Vivek —

Thanks again for the intro, Vivek. DataCloud is excited to move forward with listing on Redwood's marketplace and signing up for the AWS co-sell program. We put together an initial SOW and a short list of technical/governance asks so we can align timelines: see attached DataCloud_SOW_v1.pdf.

High-level asks:
- Confirmation of SKU/entitlement model (metering vs seat-based) and an example mapping
- Telemetry hooks: expected metering events and recommended payloads (we currently emit usage via Kafka)
- Evidence for listing (SOC2 summary, privacy whitepaper, support SLAs)
- Commercial routing: how deals are routed for co-sell and whether we need to opt-in via AWS partner portal

Target timeline: we are hoping for a staged launch: internal trial in May, public listing late June. Can we schedule a 30-min sync early next week to align owners? Ben, Vivek — copying you for ops/pm coordination.

Thanks —
Claire Park
Head of Partnerships | DataCloud Solutions
claire@datacloud.com
Attachments: DataCloud_SOW_v1.pdf
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Claire Park <claire@datacloud.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Co-sell enablement: commercial routing & telemetry checklist

Thanks Claire — welcome, and great to see the SOW. I'm available Mon/Tue mornings PT for a quick sync.

Quick answers up front:
- SKU/entitlement: Redwood supports per-token metering (preferred for LLM features) and SKU-based bundles. We'll propose a hybrid mapping for DataCloud so the marketplace shows both a bundle SKU and a metered usage SKU.
- Telemetry: our marketplace expects an event stream with usage counts and invoice keys; Kafka is fine, we'll provide a small adaptor spec to map events.
- Evidence: we can share a SOC2 summary and listing checklist; I'll attach our marketplace checklist to this thread.
- Co-sell routing: yes, you need AWS partner opt-in. We coordinate with AWS partner ops to enable co-sell attribution; I'll loop in Ben for the partner ops details.

Action items for our call:
1) Ben to walk through SKU mapping and billing integration
2) DataCloud to share a sample usage payload or Kafka topic schema
3) Ops to confirm timeline and any gating (legal/procurement deliverables)

I've attached the marketplace intake checklist for your team to review. Can you confirm availability for Mon 4/13 10:00 AM PT?

— Vivek
Senior Director, Cloud Partnerships
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-marketplace-checklist.xlsx
From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Park <claire@datacloud.com>, olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Co-sell enablement: commercial routing & telemetry checklist

Vivek / Claire — quick follow-up from our side ahead of the 10:00 AM PT sync:

Notes / proposed technical plan (high level):
- SKU mapping: propose 2 SKUs "DataCloud Core (metered)" + "DataCloud Pro (bundle)". We'll publish both; billing will record meter tokens under the Core SKU.
- Metering adapter: we provide a lightweight consumer that subscribes to your Kafka topic and emits ingestion events to Redwood's metering API. Minimal changes required on your side — mainly a consistent invoice_key and timestamp.
- Evidence: ops needs SOC2 summary, privacy policy PDF, and a contact for audit requests (procurement@datacloud.com).
- Co-sell routing: once AWS opt-in is complete, AWS partner ops will surface leads. We also support a manual routing override for named-account referrals.

Pre-call asks for DataCloud: please share a 1-page sample Kafka event (fields + example values) and the SOW section that lists billing terms. Also, include any regional constraints (EU data residency) if relevant.

I'll walk through the SKU CSV sample in the meeting (attached).

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Head of Partner Ops, Redwood Inference
Attachments: sku-mapping-proposal.csv
From: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Claire Park <claire@datacloud.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 16:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Co-sell enablement: commercial routing & telemetry checklist

Thanks all — good sync this morning. Capturing the plan and owners so we have a clear runway: 

Summary / next steps:
- Week of 4/13: DataCloud to share sample Kafka event + final SOW page for billing terms (owner: Claire).
- Week of 4/20: Ops integration sprint (owner: Ben) — implement metering adaptor, end-to-end test in staging.
- Week of 5/04: Internal trial with a restricted customer set; collect telemetry and confirm invoice keys.
- Week of 6/22: Public marketplace listing and request AWS co-sell opt-in activation.

Open risks: SOC2 evidence needs legal review; if procurement requires a custom data-processing addendum that could push listing by ~2–3 weeks. Procurement contact is procurement@datacloud.com — Claire, please loop them into the docu-sign flow.

I've uploaded a short evidence binder to the Drive link and created a DocuSign envelope for the SOW (link below). Please acknowledge the plan and add any missing items.
